intro.h2: Granite countertops in Carbondale, from the slab to the install
paragraphs: Argento Marble & Granite Inc supplies and installs granite countertops in Carbondale from its location at 1101 Dolores Way. As the name says, the company works in marble and granite, and Google lists it as a tile contractor too.

Kitchen work is the core of what the company does: its Facebook page centres on countertop projects and kitchen remodeling, and a Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation. If you are replacing tops or redoing a kitchen, call (970) 963-7070 to talk about stone, layout and timing, and ask how the project will be handled from removal of the old tops to the final install.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite is in the company name and at the center of its kitchen work. Talk with Argento about slabs for your kitchen or bath, the layout of seams and cutouts, and how the old countertops will come out before the new ones go in.

items.name: Marble countertops
items.blurb: Marble is the other half of the Argento name. It suits bathrooms, islands and spaces where you want a softer, veined look. Ask the team which stone fits how you use the room and what care each option needs.

items.name: Tile
items.blurb: Google lists Argento Marble & Granite as a tile contractor. If your project includes a tile backsplash, floor or shower alongside new countertops, ask whether the same team can handle the tile so the stone and tile are planned together.

items.name: Countertop and cabinet installation
items.blurb: A Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation by the company, with the old cabinets and countertops removed first. Plumbing and electrical work is a separate trade, so ask up front who will handle those parts of your project.

items.title: Stone is the specialty
items.text: Marble and granite are the company's name and focus, and Google also lists it as a tile contractor, so stone countertops and tile can be talked through with one company.

items.title: A local Carbondale address
items.text: Argento works from 1101 Dolores Way in Carbondale, Colorado. You can reach the office at (970) 963-7070 or by email at office@argentomarble.com.

items.title: Kitchen-focused
items.text: Kitchen remodeling and countertops are the services highlighted on the Argento Facebook page, and its project posts centre on countertop work in Carbondale.

items.title: Talk to the person in charge
items.text: A Google reviewer names Daniel as the company president. For a big kitchen project, ask to speak with him about scope and scheduling before the old tops come out.

about.text: Argento Marble & Granite Inc is a stone and tile business at 1101 Dolores Way in Carbondale, Colorado. Its work centres on marble and granite countertops for kitchens, along with tile, and a Google review describes the company carrying out a countertop and cabinet installation. The same review names Daniel as company president. The office can be reached by phone at (970) 963-7070 or by email at office@argentomarble.com, and a recent job listing for an office assistant and project estimator shows the company is growing its office team.
about.owner_role: Company president (first name only, from a Google review)

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (970) 963-7070 or email office@argentomarble.com with your room, the stone you are considering and rough measurements.

steps.title: Choose the stone
steps.text: Talk through marble, granite and tile options, and decide on edges, seams and sink or cooktop cutouts for your layout.

steps.title: Agree the scope
steps.text: Confirm in writing what Argento does, such as removal and installation, and which parts, like plumbing or electrical, other trades will handle.

steps.title: Install and check
steps.text: After installation, look over the seams, cutouts and edges with the installer, and test the sink and appliances before the crew leaves.

items.q: What does Argento Marble & Granite do?
items.a: The company works in marble and granite countertops and is listed on Google as a tile contractor. Its Facebook page lists countertops and kitchen remodeling, and a Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation. Call (970) 963-7070 to talk about your project.

items.q: Do you handle plumbing and electrical work?
items.a: Those are separate licensed trades. A past customer's project needed plumbing and electrical work to finish a countertop and cabinet installation, so before work begins, agree in writing who is responsible for disconnecting and reconnecting sinks, cooktops and outlets, and who will check that work once it is done.

Argento Marble & Granite Inc is at 1101 Dolores Way, Carbondale, CO 81623. Hours are not listed on Google, so call (970) 963-7070 or email office@argentomarble.com before visiting to make sure someone is in the office to meet you.

A Google review names Daniel as the company president. For questions about scope, scheduling or a problem with a job, ask for him by name when you call (970) 963-7070, or write to office@argentomarble.com and ask that it be passed to him.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Send rough measurements, photos of the room and the stone you like to office@argentomarble.com, or call (970) 963-7070. Prices depend on the slab, the size and the cutouts. Estimate terms are not published, so ask how pricing works when you first get in touch.

final_cta.text: Call Argento Marble & Granite in Carbondale to talk through your kitchen.
